title: FASTag Definition
text: Tag refers to FASTag issued by HDFC Bank, which shall function as a semi-closed prepaid payment instrument, the balance whereof shall be the amounts loaded/re-loaded onto such instrument by the Tag Member from time to time.

title: Tag Member Definition
text: Tag Members shall mean persons, details whereof are set out in the Tag Application, to whom Tags have been issued by HDFC Bank with respect to the vehicles owned by such persons, subject to these Terms and Conditions.

title: ETC Facility Definition
text: ETC Facility shall mean the electronic facility whereby toll payments can be effected by any Tag Member at any participating Toll Plaza by means of the Tags issued by HDFC Bank.

title: FASTag Issuance at Bank's Discretion
text: HDFC Bank may, at its sole discretion, issue a Tag to any Tag Member on a request being made by such Tag Member by submitting a duly filled in Tag Application and providing all such information and documentation required by HDFC Bank including, without limitation, any document that HDFC Bank may require to conduct its 'know-your-customer' related checks.

title: FASTag Issuance Fee
text: At the time of submitting the Tag Application for availing a Tag, the Tag Member shall be required to pay one time issuance fee of Rs. 100. The fee amount shall be mentioned on www.hdfcbank.com.

title: FASTag Affixation on Vehicle
text: The Tag issued by HDFC Bank to the Tag Member shall be mandatorily affixed by the agency/dealer of HDFC Bank or the Tag Member himself/herself on the vehicle owned by the Tag Member which carries the license plate number specified by the Tag Member in the Tag Application.

title: FASTag Activation Requirements
text: The Tags, as on the date of their issuance, shall have no assigned value and shall be in a de-activated form until the time wallet is created for every Tag issued to the Tag Member. The Tag shall be activated subject to: (i) the approval of the Tag Application by HDFC Bank; and (ii) loading of the relevant Tag by the Tag Member, for a minimum amount specified by HDFC Bank at the time of activation of the Tag.

title: User ID and Password Protection
text: A user-ID/FASTag customer ID will be generated by HDFC Bank and provided to every Tag Member at the time of issuance of the Tag to enable such Tag Member to load/reload the Tag on the HDFC Bank Website. The Tag Member shall keep all such user IDs and passwords confidential and well protected and should not reveal the same to any unauthorized person. HDFC Bank shall in no way be held responsible if the Tag Member incurs any loss as a result of disclosure.

title: Tag Balance Limits
text: The loading/reloading of any Tag shall be permitted such that the Tag Balance does not exceed Rs. 10,000/- for Minimum KYC wallet and Rs. 2,00,000/- for Full KYC wallet or such other amount as HDFC Bank may stipulate from time to time. Cash loading is limited to Rs. 50,000/- per month and Rs. 5,000/- per reload, subject to overall limits.

title: FASTag Validity and Non-Transferability
text: The Tag is valid only in India and only with respect to payments required to be made in INR towards Toll Plazas, Parking Lots, Fuel Stations and other Transit use cases. The Tag is strictly not transferable and shall only be used with respect to the vehicle owned by the Tag Member. The Tag is the property of HDFC Bank and is non-transferable. No interest shall be payable by HDFC Bank on the amount available/loaded on the Tag.

title: FASTag Usage at Toll Plazas
text: The Tag may be used by the Tag Member for the purpose of making toll payments at participating Toll Plazas on the National Highways at the electronic toll collection lanes provided at such participating Toll Plazas. The list of the participating Toll Plazas will be uploaded on the HDFC Bank Website and will be updated from time to time.

title: Tag Balance Limit Compliance
text: The Tag Member is not allowed to exceed the available Tag Balance, whether through an individual Transaction or a series of Transactions. The Tag Member acknowledges and agrees that if it attempts to drive through any electronic toll collection lane at any participating Toll Plaza where the toll amount to be paid is in excess of the Tag Balance, it will not be able to do so.

title: Negative Tag Balance Liability
text: In any event, if a Transaction amount exceeds the Tag Balance which leads to a negative Tag Balance, the Tag Member shall remain fully liable to HDFC Bank for the amount of such negative Tag Balance and shall make payment of the same to HDFC Bank on demand.

title: Transaction Proof and Burden of Proof
text: Any Transaction undertaken at a participating Toll Plaza shall be conclusive proof that the charge recorded for such Transaction was actually incurred by the Tag Member using the Tag, except in cases where the Tag had been lost, stolen or fraudulently misused, in which case, the burden of proving that the Transaction was not affected by the Tag Member shall be on such Tag Member.

title: FASTag Blacklist and Low Balance List
text: The Tag Member agrees that the Tag may be added to a black list/low balance list or such other list as may be instructed by regulatory authorities. This occurs if: (a) any governmental authority requests HDFC Bank to add the relevant Tag in a blacklist for any reason whatsoever; or (b) if the Tag Balance falls below a threshold limit stipulated by HDFC Bank, the relevant Tag shall be added to a low-balance list.

title: Lost or Stolen Tag Reporting
text: If the Tag is lost or stolen, the Tag Member must immediately report such loss/theft over the telephone to the Customer Care. On receipt of such intimation, the Bank shall, during working hours on a working day, upon adequate verification of the Tag Member, hotlist/cancel/suspend/block the Tag. The Tag Member will be liable for all charges incurred on the Tag until the Tag is reported lost/stolen.

title: FASTag Surrender and Replacement Rights
text: The Tag Member agrees and acknowledges that HDFC Bank shall be entitled to demand the surrender of any Tag at any time, including at a time prior to the expiry of the validity period of such Tag. The Tag Member shall, forthwith upon such demand being made, surrender the relevant Tag in accordance with the instructions provided by HDFC Bank.

title: FASTag Validity Period
text: A Tag shall be valid up to a period of 5 (Five) years from the date of issuance of the Tag.

title: KYC Update and Credit Freeze
text: As per the RBI guidelines on prepaid instruments, if KYC status of the FASTag wallet is not updated to FULL KYC within 24 months from the date of issuance, then the minimum KYC wallet would be marked as Credit Freeze and would be deactivated. HDFC Bank shall be entitled to, at any time, with or without notice to the Tag Member, at its absolute discretion, terminate/de-activate any Tag.

title: Tag Termination and Interest on Outstanding Balance
text: On termination of any Tag, the negative balance in respect of the Tag (if any) and any other amounts due in respect of the Tag shall become forthwith due and payable by the Tag Member and interest will accrue thereon at such rates as may be stipulated by HDFC Bank, from the date of such deactivation till the date of actual payment.

title: Tag Deactivation and Refund Process
text: The Tag Member may, at any point of time, request for deactivation of the Tag by visiting any branch of HDFC Bank or any Kiosk. The Tag Member shall be required to return the existing Tag to the authorized HDFC Bank personnel. The Tag Balance (if any) shall be returned to the Tag Member by crediting the same into its bank account within 15 (Fifteen) days from the date of the request for deactivation.

title: Tag Closure Refund Options
text: In case Tag Member has a HDFC bank account, the Tag closure request proceeds will be processed into the said account. In a situation wherein the Tag Member does not have a requisite account opened with HDFC Bank, then the amounts will be processed through Demand Draft (DD) and dispatched on registered address or vide NEFT to the account details provided.

title: Indemnity by Tag Member
text: In consideration of HDFC Bank providing the Tag Member with the Tag, the Tag Member hereby agrees to indemnify and keep HDFC Bank and its officers, directors, employees, shareholders, agents, consultants and other representatives indemnified from all actions, claims, suits, demands, proceedings, losses, damages arising from: (a) provision of the ETC Facility; (b) the negligence, mistake or misconduct of any Tag Member; (c) breach or non-compliance by the Tag Member of these Terms and Conditions; (d) any claim made by any third party; and/or (e) fraud or dishonesty relating to any Transaction.

title: Exclusion from Liability
text: HDFC Bank shall not be liable to the Tag Member for any loss or damage whatsoever in connection with the ETC Facility, including any loss arising from: (a) any defect or issues in respect of the relevant participating Toll Plaza; (b) the refusal of any person to honour or to accept the Tag; (c) the malfunction of any computer system; (d) handing over of the Tag by the Tag Member to anybody other than designated employees; (e) loss of data contained in the servers; and/or (f) any interruption or stoppage in the Tag Member's access to and/or the use of the Tags.

title: Charges and Discounts
text: HDFC Bank may provide such discounts and offers as it deems fit, from time to time, in relation to the charges applicable for issue and use of Tags, which may be subject to such terms and conditions as HDFC Bank may stipulate from time to time.

title: Government Charges and Taxes
text: Any government charges, duty, debits or tax payable as a result of the use of the Tag shall be borne solely by the Tag Member and if the same is imposed upon HDFC Bank (either directly or indirectly), the Tag Member agrees that HDFC Bank shall be entitled to debit such charges from the available Tag Balance.

title: Service Charges and Tag Balance Debit
text: HDFC Bank shall be entitled to levy appropriate service and other charges for use of the Tag, which charges shall be notified to the Tag Member from time to time. The Tag Member hereby authorizes HDFC Bank to recover all such charges by debiting the available Tag Balance.

title: Dispute Reporting Timeframe
text: The Tag Member shall inform HDFC Bank, by contacting the Customer Care number within 15 (Fifteen) days of occurrence of any Transaction, if any irregularities or discrepancies exist in such Transaction or if such Tag Member has any query or complaint. If HDFC Bank does not receive any information to the contrary within 15 (Fifteen) days, it shall be entitled to assume that the relevant Transaction(s) was effected without any discrepancy.

title: Dispute Resolution Process
text: HDFC Bank shall make bona fide and reasonable efforts to resolve an aggrieved Tag Member's complaints/queries in relation to any Transaction within 15 (Fifteen) days of receipt of intimation of such complaint. If after such effort, HDFC Bank determines that the Transaction in question is correct and valid, it shall communicate the same to the Tag Member in writing, along with the justification pertaining to the same.

title: Image Capturing at Toll Plazas
text: The Tag Member agrees and acknowledges that image capturing cameras shall be installed at participating Toll Plazas for the purpose of serving as evidence in relation to settlement of disputes raised by the Tag Member.

title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
text: The Tag Members hereby irrevocably authorize HDFC Bank to disclose, exchange, share or part with any information relating to the Tag Members including payment history information to and between its branches, subsidiaries, affiliates, representatives, auditors, sub-contractors, service providers, other banks/financial institutions, credit bureaus and governmental authorities as may be deemed necessary by HDFC Bank.

title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
text: The construction and validity of these Terms and Conditions shall be governed in all respects by the laws of India. HDFC Bank and the Tag Member agree that any legal action or proceeding arising out of these Terms and Conditions shall be brought before the courts or tribunals at Mumbai and irrevocably submit themselves to the jurisdiction of that court or tribunal.

title: Amendment of Terms and Conditions
text: HDFC Bank shall have the absolute discretion to, at any point of time, (a) amend or supplement any of these Terms and Conditions; and/or (b) change any feature and/or benefit offered on the Tag including changes which affect charges or rates. HDFC Bank shall communicate the amended Terms and Conditions by hosting the same on the HDFC Bank Website or in any other manner as may be decided by HDFC Bank.

title: Set-Off and Lien Rights
text: In respect of all and any of the Tag Member's present and future liabilities to HDFC Bank, HDFC Bank shall in addition to any general lien have a specific and special lien on all the Tag Member's present and future stocks, shares, securities, property, book debts, all moneys in all accounts held with HDFC Bank. HDFC Bank shall have an express right to set-off, transfer, sell, realise, adjust, appropriate all such amounts without notice to and without consent of the Tag Member.
